card.title: 3rd MARINE REGIMENT
card.flavorText: During WWII the 3rd Marine Regiment was attached to the 2nd Marine Brigade. They fought at Bougainville and Guam and during this period their members were awarded four Medals of Honor for their acts of valor. During the Battle of Iwo Jima the 3rd Marines were kept in reserve and were not sent ashore.
